title: The Jio IPO
summary:
Mukesh Ambani first promised a Jio listing in 2019. In 2020, Facebook, Google and other global investors bought big stakes in Jio Platforms. The listing then slipped year after year. In August 2025, Ambani set a new target of the first half of 2026, but war in West Asia unsettled markets and pushed the plan back again.

The draft prospectus finally went to the market regulator on 19 June 2026, and the regulator cleared it on 28 August. The issue is made up only of new shares, and most of the money will repay debt at Reliance Jio Infocomm. On 14 October, Jio set a price band of 1,065 to 1,119 rupees a share. That makes it a record offer of about 30,200 crore rupees. On 19 October, anchor investors put in about 8,110 crore rupees, with bids around 30 times the shares on offer. The offer opened to the public on 21 October, with lenders offering short-term loans to retail buyers.
watch: The offer is open from Wednesday, 21 October, to Friday, 23 October. Watch the daily subscription numbers, especially from retail investors and Reliance shareholders, who have their own quota of 2,500 crore rupees. Share allotment is expected on 26 October, and listing on 28 October. The big open question is how the shares trade on day one, given a valuation of around 10.3 lakh crore rupees.

timeline.title: Ambani first promises a Jio listing
timeline.text: At the Reliance annual general meeting, Mukesh Ambani said Jio and Reliance Retail would move towards a stock market listing. He gave a time frame of within the next five years. This is where the Jio IPO story begins.

sources.title: RIL 42nd AGM live updates: Mukesh Ambani launches Jio GigaFiber, Jio Phone 3

timeline.title: Facebook buys nearly 10 percent of Jio
timeline.text: Facebook agreed to invest 43,574 crore rupees in Jio Platforms. That bought it a stake of 9.99 percent. The deal valued Jio Platforms at about 4.62 lakh crore rupees, and it set off a wave of global investment into the company.

Facebook Buys 9.99% Stake in Jio Platforms for Rs43,574 crore

timeline.title: Google takes a 7.73 percent stake
timeline.text: At the next annual general meeting, Ambani announced that Google would invest 33,737 crore rupees in Jio Platforms. Google would get a stake of 7.73 percent. Bloomberg later noted that a listing would give big global investors like these a way to exit.

sources.title: Google to buy 7.73% stake in Jio Platforms
Google To Invest Rs 33,737 Crore For A 7.7% Stake In Jio Platforms

timeline.title: Reuters: no Jio IPO in 2025
timeline.text: Reuters reported that Jio would not list in 2025, citing people familiar with the matter. The sources said Jio first wanted more revenue and more subscribers. Analysts already valued the company at more than 100 billion dollars.

sources.title: Exclusive-Ambani's Reliance Jio delays India IPO beyond this year, sources say

timeline.title: Ambani targets a listing by mid 2026
timeline.text: At the Reliance annual general meeting, Ambani said Jio aimed to list in the first half of 2026. He said Jio was making all arrangements to file for its IPO. He did not say how big a stake would be sold.

sources.title: Ambani Targets Reliance Jio's IPO by June Ending Years of Wait
Reliance Jio eyes IPO in first half of 2026: Chairman Mukesh Ambani

timeline.title: Jio weighs selling a 2.5 percent stake
timeline.text: Reuters reported that Jio was considering floating about 2.5 percent of the company. That depended on a proposed rule change that would let very large companies sell a smaller slice. The offer could be worth more than 4 billion dollars, and the brokerage Jefferies had valued Jio at about 180 billion dollars.

sources.title: Ambani's Reliance Jio considers 2.5% public offering in 2026 India IPO, sources say

timeline.title: War in West Asia clouds the timeline
timeline.text: A report from the research firm CreditSights said the Jio listing could slip to the second half of the financial year, between October 2026 and March 2027. The reason was rising tension in West Asia. That meant the target of the first half of 2026 was likely to be missed.

sources.title: Jio IPO may slip to second half of FY27 on geopolitical risks: Report
Reliance JIO IPO Timeline Likely Pushed to H2 FY27 Amid Geopolitical Tensions: Report

timeline.title: Jio switches to an all new share issue
timeline.text: Bloomberg reported that Jio had slowed its preparations as markets fell about 9 percent below pre war levels. Jio dropped the plan to let existing shareholders sell their stakes. Instead, the IPO would only issue new shares.

sources.title: $4 billion Jio IPO hits roadblocks on impact of West Asia conflict
War-Induced Uncertainty May Again Delay Jio's $4 Billion Public Listing

timeline.title: Draft prospectus filed at the annual meeting
timeline.text: At the Reliance annual general meeting, Ambani said the Jio board had approved the draft red herring prospectus. It was filed with the market regulator, the Securities and Exchange Board of India, the same day. The plan was a fresh issue of up to 27 crore shares.

sources.title: Reliance arm Jio Platforms approves DRHP for proposed IPO
Reliance Jio IPO To Open On Oct 21, Files RHP

timeline.title: Market regulator clears the IPO
timeline.text: The market regulator issued its observation letter on the draft prospectus, which clears the way for the offer. Early estimates put the issue at around 37,700 crore rupees. The draft prospectus said about 27,500 crore rupees would repay borrowings of Reliance Jio Infocomm.

sources.title: RIL says Jio Platforms receives SEBI observation letter for proposed IPO
Jio Platforms Gets SEBI Approval For ₹37,700 Crore IPO

timeline.title: Reports point to an October 21 opening
timeline.text: Citing Moneycontrol, reports said the offer would likely open on 21 October and list on 28 October. Most of the money would go to repay about 27,500 crore rupees of Reliance Jio Infocomm debt. Pricing and valuation were still not decided.

sources.title: Jio Platforms IPO Likely To Open October 21; ₹27,500 Crore Debt Repayment Planned

timeline.title: Price band set for a record offer
timeline.text: Jio filed its final prospectus and set a price band of 1,065 to 1,119 rupees a share. At the top of the band, the offer raises about 30,200 crore rupees, the largest IPO in India. Up to 2,500 crore rupees is set aside for Reliance shareholders, and up to 500 crore rupees for employees. Reuters said the top price values Jio at around 10.3 lakh crore rupees.

sources.title: Jio Platforms sets IPO price band at Rs 1,065-1,119, targets to raise record Rs 30,213 cr
Reliance Jio IPO To Open On Oct 21, Files RHP

timeline.title: Anchor investors put in 8,110 crore rupees
timeline.text: Jio raised about 8,110 crore rupees from 212 anchor investors, all at the top price of 1,119 rupees. Bids reportedly topped 2.5 lakh crore rupees, around 30 times the shares on offer. Investors included Singapore's government, the Abu Dhabi Investment Authority and Norway's sovereign fund, while Life Insurance Corporation got about 500 crore rupees of shares.

sources.title: Jio Platforms raises Rs 8,110 crore from over 200 anchor investors; draws Rs 2.5 lakh cr demand
Jio Platforms' anchor book draws record ₹2.5 trillion in bids ahead of IPO

timeline.title: Brokerages weigh in on the eve of the IPO
timeline.text: On the eve of the offer, Mint reported that the brokerage Motilal Oswal rated the issue subscribe, both for listing gains and for the long term. It pointed to Jio's market leadership and growth in broadband and enterprise services. Allotment is expected on 26 October, with listing on 28 October.

timeline.title: The offer opens to the public
timeline.text: The Jio Platforms offer opened for subscription, aiming to raise about 30,213 crore rupees through a fresh issue of 27 crore shares. Mint reported that non-bank lenders and brokerages were offering short-term loans and heavy marketing to draw in retail buyers. Akash Ambani told Moneycontrol that Jio is entering public markets to build a sustainable business with many growth engines.
